title: An Empirical Benchmark of Deep Time-Series Models for Smart Meter Energy Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2608.18675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Accurate forecasting of energy consumption is important for the efficient operation of power systems, with direct implications for operational costs, energy management, and system maintenance. Due to the availability of extensive high-resolution consumption data from smart meters, data-driven methods have been used for short-term and long-term forecasting. However, their comparative performance on real-world smart meter data is still not well studied. In this paper, we present an empirical benchmark of nine modern deep learning models for time-series forecasting, including linear, MLP-based, convolutional, and Transformer architectures. translated_title: 深度时间序列模型在智能电表能耗预测中的实证基准研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.18675v1 公告类型：新 摘要：能源消耗的准确预测对于电力系统的高效运行至关重要，直接影响运营成本、能源管理和系统维护。由于智能电表提供了大量高分辨率的消费数据，数据驱动方法已被用于短期和长期预测。然而，它们在真实世界智能电表数据上的比较性能尚未得到充分研究。在本文中，我们提出了一个针对时间序列预测的九个现代深度学习模型的实证基准，包括线性、基于MLP、卷积和Transformer架构。我们在两个公开可用的智能电表数据集上评估这些模型。我们的分析聚焦于三个强烈影响预测性能的因素：历史输入长度、预测范围以及模型架构的选择。我们表明，扩展历史上下文能改善预测效果。
tldr: 本文通过实证基准比较了九种现代深度学习模型在智能电表能耗预测中的性能，发现历史输入长度、预测范围和模型架构是影响预测效果的关键因素。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically benchmarks nine modern deep learning models for smart meter energy forecasting, revealing that historical input length, prediction horizon, and model architecture are key factors affecting performance.
